notes: Save ladder route (ladders\Stray.json): the harness installs the rung's save as slot 3 (save_slot), a copy of the user's Slot_1 (Control Room, MaxUnlockedChapterName=ControlRoom, so all 12 chapters are listed). 게임 시작 > slot 3 > 챕터 선택 > chapter ${chapter_index} > '챕터를 다시 시작하시겠습니까?' 예 > loading + the chapter's opening (load_wait_s) > Esc: the pause menu is the loaded marker > Esc (resume) > play ~3 min > pause > up (나가기) > 예 (to the main menu) > 나가기 > 예. Chapter select (recorded 2026-10-03, runs\discover\stray-ch): a horizontal carousel of 12 cards over the dimmed save select; the 12 dots under it (y 574-577) show the selected chapter (white, the others gray), so chapter_N is a highlight checkpoint on dot N. The cursor starts on chapter 1 and Right wraps from 12 to 1, so one seek with Right reaches any chapter (Left goes back). Enter asks '챕터를 다시 시작하시겠습니까?' (orange band, 아니요 preselected, 예 to its right: yes_selected). Chapter names in this UI: 1 벽의 안쪽, 2 데드 시티, 3 아파트, 4 슬럼, 5 옥상, 6 슬럼 - 파트 2, 7 막다른 골목, 8 하수도, 9 앤트빌리지, 10 미드타운, 11 감옥, 12 제어실. Measured from Enter on 예 to the cat moving (warm cache, 2026-10-03): ch1 ~50 s (load ~5 s, then the letterboxed opening with the cat family), ch2 ~15, ch3 ~9, ch4 ~15 (the cat lies down until a key), ch5 ~12, ch6 ~24 (short cutscene, then the area title), ch7 ~9, ch8 ~9, ch9 ~9, ch10 ~24 (short cutscene), ch11 ~18 (the cat starts in a hanging cage: W/A/S/D swing it), ch12 ~27 (subway cutscene); the ladder rungs' load_wait_s add ~5 s, and the pause-menu check after it waits up to 60 s more. The pause menu (Esc) is 재개 / 설정 / 나가기 before the chapter's first checkpoint and 재개 / 설정 / 마지막 체크포인트 다시 불러오기 / 나가기 after it (everything 27 px lower); it opens during cutscenes too (no skip), so it proves the level is loaded, not that the cat can move; it sometimes opens by itself (seen twice after 15-20 min), so the steps press Esc when pause_menu shows between play segments. Its cursor starts on 재개 and wraps: up from 재개 is 나가기 in both layouts. The pause item checkpoints are 2x14 px inside a stroke of the selected (white) word: unselected words are gray and see-through, so a larger region would follow the scene's brightness; a bright sky can match them too, so they are only checked after pause_menu (the ENTER/ESC key hints) shows. Chapter select rewrites slot 3 (its Continue point moves to the chosen chapter); that is the test copy, the next rung installs the save again. Never 지우기 (deletes the slot): the submenu seek presses down at most once from 계속. Keys: arrows move menu cursors (white box / white text = selected), Enter select, Esc back/pause, W/A/S/D walk, Space jump (only where the game offers it), mouse camera; Q/E are interaction prompts (not used). Dialogs (orange band) default to 아니요; 예 is right of it. The menu background (a cat walking) is animated: checkpoints sit on text and the dots.

steps.note: slot 3 is the test slot the harness installed the rung's save into; slot 1 (the user's Control Room save) and slot 2 are never opened. slot3_selected is the selected card's bright right border (thumbnail-independent; the left one has the drifting cat watermark behind it at 16:9)
the submenu (계속 / 챕터 선택 / 지우기) opens under the selected card: slot3_continue_selected only matches under slot 3, so a submenu under slot 1 or 2 stops the run here before any Enter
one down from 계속 is 챕터 선택; the seek never presses down a second time (지우기 is below)

loading + the chapter's opening (per chapter: the rung's load_wait_s)
